includes: Professional tour company with over 15 years' experience
4 stops for a hop-off experience at essential landmarks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

blurb:
Discover St Paul your way on the city’s only Hop-On Hop-Off sightseeing tour aboard a comfortable, 360-degree view coach bus. This guided, easygoing experience lets you explore the city’s must-see attractions while enjoying interesting history, great views, and the best of summer in St Paul all around you. Designed for those short on time but big on seeing.

Maximize your time with 4 targeted stops where you’ll have time to hop off the bus, walk around, take photos, and dive into the history and culture of each location then hopping back on with your friendly driver-guide.

This unique hop-on hop-off tour is the only local experience that includes hop-off opportunities at the city’s top attractions.

Enjoy the ride as your professional guide shares stories that connect the dots between St Paul’s iconic landmarks, scenic areas, and hidden gems.

Perfect for first-time visitors and locals alike, this small group tour offers a relaxed, engaging way to experience the city in motion.
